written.myAnswer: Google Docs is an online word-processing tool for creating, editing, and storing documents. It allows multiple users to work on and collaborate on the same document in real time.

An e-commerce platform is software that enables a business to sell products or services online. It is important because it helps businesses create and manage online stores, process payments, and serve customers.

Market research tools help a business understand its customers, competitors, and market trends. Online marketing tools help it promote its products and reach potential customers. An e-commerce platform enables it to sell products online and manage transactions and customer service. Used together, they support informed decisions, effective promotion, and online sales.
